notes.text: “The brief puts the start at The Cyber Boardroom, "when I actually started really pushing it".” (ch. 11b, line 128)
“The newsroom is where the plumbing became a way of working” (ch. 11b, line 164)
“an issue tracker in which the issues are files” (ch. 11b, line 154)
“version control with git's model, encrypted, so that a repository can live on a server that cannot read it” (ch. 11b, line 158)
